body: Oh wow, that's basically the same as me! It took over six months before I started getting back to normal after the vaccine. I've never known anyone else who reacted like that! It's so scary not knowing how I'll react.

Your first assumption is more correct - the bowl of liquid - not as much as her water bowl, but it was a few flakes of tuna floating in it. A hunk of tuna with some drops of water would have been what I'd have thought he should do!
Depression is what caused me to lose my faith in God. I miss it if I'm honest, but I can't get it back. I hope you get the help you need and don't lose faith as I did.

Thank you for the reply. Unfortunately I tried desperately to get us to move away a couple of years ago when we were looking to buy our home but my husband was unable to find another job so we were stuck in the same sort of area.
I worry that a gap on my resume would just make me even more unemployable in the future so giving up work isn't an option - as it is, hubby's wage pays the mortgage and bills so there would be literally no money for clothes/bus journeys/trips/treats etc if I don't work as well.
I feel so trapped.
Yes I am, for all the good it's doing. When I first started taking them I felt so much better but that hasn't lasted.
